alert.name: [Critical] LLM provider error rate high on kaiops-model-router - occurrence 06 test
alert.description:
KaiOps historical monitoring incident for contextual RCA retrieval.

ALERT DETAILS
- Alert: LLM provider error rate high
- Service: kaiops-model-router
- Source: KaiOps Synthetic Monitor
- Environment: Pre-Production
- Evidence: Model calls returned 429/5xx above 8%; occurrence 6/20. KaiOps correlation found 3 related signals across 2 monitored resources.
- Correlation ID: INC-2025-10986

ROOT CAUSE
Primary provider quota was exhausted by an unbounded summarization workflow.

BUSINESS IMPACT
kaiops-model-router experienced major production degradation; approximately 4898 transactions or operational events were delayed or failed. Incident response and business operations were at risk of SLA breach.

RESOLUTION STEPS
1. Route to approved fallback model.
2. enforce token and concurrency budgets.
3. repair summarization batching.

VALIDATION
Model error rate below 1%, queue age normal, and cost guardrails show no breach.

PREVENTION
Add regression coverage for llm provider error rate high; retain the alert with early-warning threshold; track recurrence using scenario label kaiops-scenario-50; review capacity/configuration during the next problem-management cycle.
